I have. You expect to receive silver, I offer you health; for bodily health is better than immeasurable wealth. I will tell you the truth: I do not have silver or gold. Christ gave us authority, saying: Do not acquire gold or silver or copper. He gave us authority, saying: Cast out demons, heal the sick, cleanse lepers. Freely you received, freely give. In the name of Jesus Christ, rise and walk. The servant raises by taking the hand, the master heals with a word. A servant is not greater than his master. But as I see medical facilities opening throughout the world, I see Christ standing as a doctor over all. What a new wonder. Different diseases in different hospital areas are treated by one doctor. One person, bound by the wound of sin, comes and, having received a plaster of healing from fasting, departs. Another, having put away the stench of fornication, receives medicinal treatment for the foul smell from Christ, the doctor of souls and bodies. Another, burning with the fever of love of money, having been relieved by fasting, brings remedies for the disease. He knows how to make sterile women conceive and make the barren womb a fertile field, and to give prophets as a reward to those who fast.

You see what kind of fruits it produces for those who need its own, how it dries up the springs of fornication, and the dried-up ones it opens with childlessness of womb, and the thorns of sin which grow from thoughts it cuts off…
pass_b_english: Bodily health is more valuable than any amount of wealth, so I offer you health instead of the silver you were expecting to receive.
To be honest, I don't have any silver or gold to give you.
Christ has given us authority, and he instructed us, saying: 'Do not acquire gold or silver or copper' (Matthew 10:9).
He also gave us the authority to cast out demons, heal the sick, and cleanse lepers, reminding us that since we received our gifts freely, we should give freely as well (Matthew 10:8).
In the name of Jesus Christ, we are commanded to rise and walk.
While a servant may help someone up by taking their hand, the master heals with just a word.
It's clear that a servant is not greater than their master.
As medical facilities open around the world, I see Christ standing over all of them as the ultimate doctor.
What's remarkable is that different diseases, located in various hospital areas, are all treated by one doctor - Christ.
One person, struggling with the wound of sin, comes to Christ and, after receiving healing through fasting, departs.
Another person, having turned away from the stench of fornication, receives treatment for their spiritual foul smell from Christ, who heals both souls and bodies.
Then there's the person consumed by the fever of love for money, who, after being relieved through fasting, is able to find remedies for their disease.
Christ knows how to make sterile women conceive and turn a barren womb into a fertile field, giving prophets as a reward to those who fast.
The Bible tells us that Anna was in anguish, wept, and did not eat, but fasting gave the prophet Samuel to the barren woman.

Through fasting, Christ gives prophets as a reward to those who fast, and it has the power to dry up the sources of fornication, open the withered womb, and cut away the thorns of sin that sprout from our thoughts.
